text: Burning coal, oil and gas releases carbon dioxide, the main cause of recent global warming.
What is the main cause of climate change? Students often ask this question in class.
Greenhouse gases trap heat in the atmosphere like a blanket around the Earth.
Sea levels are rising because warmer ocean water expands and glaciers melt.
Melting ice sheets in Greenland and Antarctica add water to the oceans.
Forests absorb carbon dioxide from the air as trees grow.
Solar panels and wind turbines generate electricity without burning fuel.
